notes: Endpoint labels describe test intent; capability-gated cases do not claim that a route was generated.
Historical service clock is fixed; walking and timing mutations are synthetic, never live evidence.
Mikrotrans route candidates are selected by category from the optional full-feed inspection.
Northbound Kota-area control uses Kali Besar G00060; Kota G00061 is a southbound call in this snapshot. The sweep retains an unavailable northbound G00061 pair as a directional control.
Supersedes active v1 tests: all requested motorized services are TransJakarta agency Tije. Historical v1 is retained unchanged.
Network source audits are separate from actual application routing results.
v3 evaluates platform/origin improvements. Single-route rejection probes remain legacy schema-v1 contract tests; broader runtime network support is measured in the paired improvement suite.

cases.assertion: Verify weekly exclusion; missing holiday exceptions remain unknown.

cases.title: One-minute connection delay
cases.assertion: An extra minute of access can exhaust the last boarding window.

cases.title: Five-minute connection delay
cases.assertion: A five-minute delay must not retain a departed connection.

cases.title: Visit plus 30 minutes
cases.assertion: An extension that exceeds the accepted finish deadline is rejected.

cases.title: Outbound only
cases.assertion: An available outbound ride does not establish return service.

cases.title: 800-metre access cutoff
cases.assertion: Test 799, 800 and 801 metres around the actual search cutoff.

cases.title: 20-minute walking cutoff
cases.assertion: 1199 and 1200 seconds pass; 1201 seconds is unavailable.

cases.title: Third-nearest valid platform
cases.assertion: Route-aware discovery finds the third usable platform despite two closer decoys.

cases.title: Accessibility constraint
cases.assertion: No structured wheelchair or per-user walking constraint is supported.

cases.title: Six geographically spread venues
cases.assertion: Report catalog rejection before pretending to evaluate citywide routing.

cases.title: Mandatory venue deadline
cases.assertion: Keep mandatory venue identity and reject an impossible plan.

cases.title: Personalized TJ coffee and Wi-Fi
cases.assertion: The sourced coffee/Wi-Fi preference remains intact throughout a complete TJ-only itinerary.

cases.title: Invalid stop counts
cases.assertion: Reject both counts without dropping destinations silently.

cases.title: Timeout and partial walking
cases.assertion: Missing callback times out; unavailable access prevents a bus journey.

cases.title: Stale feed and geometry mismatch
cases.assertion: Reject stale routing data and geometry with the wrong source hash.

cases.title: Cancel and restart TJ work
cases.assertion: An in-flight cancelled TJ walking operation terminates; a fresh TJ request succeeds independently.

cases.title: Save reopen export reject
cases.assertion: Rejected revision leaves the accepted plan and its bus proof intact.
